result.title: HiGenTrans: Hierarchical LLM Knowledge Transfer for Generative Recommendation
result.summary: Generative recommendation promises to simplify conventional multi-stage recommender systems by generating item Semantic IDs (SIDs) autoregressively. However, two obstacles limit its effective- ness in industrial settings: interaction-only supervision underuses the semantic knowledge encoded in pretrained language models, while beam-search likelihood ranks token sequences rather than directly estimating item relevance. To address these limitations, we propose HiGenTrans, a three-level framework that introduces LLM knowledge at the input, representation, and decision levels. First, Global Semantic Priming (GSP) adds an LLM-derived user representation to the beginning-of-sequence embedding, provid- ing a semantic prior before SID generation. Second, Hierarchi- cal Representation Transfer (HRT) aligns intermediate LLM representations with depth-matched GenRec layers through mean- centered projections and gated residual connections. Finally, Multi- Signal Decision Calibration (MDC) uses a lightweight mixture- of-experts calibrator to combine semantic relevance, generation confidence, and candidate-set context when reranking beam-search outputs. All semantic features are computed only from the observ- able interaction prefix, preventing target leakage, and can be cached offline. Experiments on three public benchmarks show that HiGen- Trans improves Recall@10 by up to 12.9% and NDCG@10 by up to 33.7% over the strongest baselines. These results demonstrate the value of transferring LLM knowledge at complementary stages of the generative recommendation pipeline.

AI.brief_summary: HiGenTrans 提出三级框架，在输入、表示和决策三个层面把预训练 LLM 知识迁移到生成式推荐的 Semantic ID 自回归生成中，包括用户语义先验注入、层级表示对齐与重排校准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按深度对齐中间表示（mean-centered 投影加门控残差）与多信号重排，可能为 LVR 中不同层 latent 状态的语义对齐、注入及生成结果筛选提供训练侧线索，但任务是推荐且无视觉推理，需核查可迁移性。
